title: Report lost/stolen/missing/damaged — exception recorded with evidence
objective: Verify POST /assets/:uuid/report-exception records the exception type, narrative, and evidence, transitions status per rules, and emits lifecycle + audit events.
preconditions: employee E with assigned asset (self-report path); operator session; assigned asset.
test_data: (a) {type: lost, note: 'Left on train', evidence: <attachment uuid if supported>} by custodian; (b) {type: damaged, note: 'Dropped'} by operator
steps: As custodian E: report lost on own assigned asset.
Verify asset status transitions (lost) and exception record persisted.
As operator: report damaged on in-scope asset.
Verify lifecycle + audit events for both.
expected_result: Exception recorded with type/reporter/timestamp/evidence; status per transition rules; custodian self-report allowed for own assets; events audited.

title: Resolution preserves original event — no erasure
objective: Verify resolving an exception (e.g., lost asset recovered) creates a resolution event while the original exception remains intact in history (BR-003).
test_data: resolution {action: recovered, note: 'Found in storage', resulting_status: in_stock}
steps: Resolve the exception via delivered endpoint/flow.
Verify asset status updated per resolution.
Verify history shows BOTH the original lost report and the resolution, unedited.
expected_result: Resolution appended; original exception immutable; full trail in activity feed/history; audit events for resolution.

title: Exception reporting authorization
objective: Verify employees can report exceptions only on own-custody assets; others' assets and out-of-scope reports denied; auditor cannot report.
preconditions: employee E (custodian of A, not of B); auditor session; asset C out of E's custody.
test_data: exception payloads for assets B and C
steps: As E: report exception on B and C → expect 403/404.
As auditor: report on any asset → 403.
expected_result: Denied with envelope codes; no exception records created; auditor fully read-only.
